<document source="data/kb/payments.md">
Payments - Accepted payment methods
Brindlewick Audio accepts Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal. Cash on delivery and personal checks are not accepted. All prices are charged in US dollars.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/gift-cards.md">
Gift Cards - Expiry and refunds
Brindlewick Audio gift cards never expire. Gift cards cannot be refunded, returned, or exchanged for cash.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/repairs.md">
Out-of-Warranty Repairs - Repair fees
Products outside their warranty period can be repaired for a flat fee. A headphone repair costs $39 and a speaker repair costs $59. The fee includes parts, labor, and return shipping.
</document>
